title: A mind is a pure composite with no subsystem as such

statements.text: Purity gives an individuation criterion for the combination problem: a conscious mind is a composite system in an ontic state undergoing an ontic transformation, with no subsystem as such. Entangled parts have only epistemic marginal states, and merging two individuals needs a quantum interaction.

sources.quote: S4: A conscious mind is a composite system in an ontic state undergoing an ontic transformation, with no subsystem as such.
The present theoretical approach provides a precise individuation criterion.
